services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: When in paradise, you’ve most likely got a marvelous sunset in mind - our sunset cruise is the best possible way to experience just that. Sprinkle a bit of magic onto your relaxing evening with drinks such as wine and beer, alongside a complimentary champagne toast. Whatever you’ve got in your glass, you won’t lift a finger on this calming boat ride as you soak up the rosy golden hues of the sunset. You’ll feel right at home on Blue, our enormous and comfortable catamaran, as our crew handles all of the logistics. Seasonal based on time of sunset (exact departure time will be confirmed during the booking process) Complimentary champagne toast provided. Bottled water and soda available for

services.name: SNUBA
services.desc: SNUBA Dive Experience life beneath the sea with a guided SNUBA dive. Yep, we spelled that right! No certifications are necessary for this type of diving. After a brief safety and equipment lesson, you’ll be ready to explore our underwater world! You can dive up to 20 feet beneath the surface and come face to face with sea turtles, puffers, rays and a large assortment of other fish and marine life. It’s like swimming in an oversized aquarium, only better! Ages 8+ and up and the ability to swim is required. Some medical restrictions apply. If you have any questions about your medical ability please contact us prior to making a reservation. Must be able to swim and speak conversational English

services.desc: About Explore Crystal Blue Waters >A trip to the sandbar makes for the perfect alternative to snorkeling when the weather doesn't cooperate. This 2.5 hour trip visits White Marlin sandbar located on the bayside. We have pool noodles and life jackets to keep the fun going for all ages.
